_comment: Future note: use rainbow-white as the base white for the light theme; keep room for a dedicated base-white token if the palette grows.
_neutralComment: Use eigengrau as the dark neutral base. Build neutral contrast with alpha variants of eigengrau, pure-white, or pure-black instead of adding more Eigengrau tones.
_accentComment: Non-neutral colors should be only the Radiohead base colors: maize, tufts-blue, flame, mantis, amber, off-red, and non-photo-blue. Theme variants should append alpha to the base hex.
